wa-benchmark.text: Borrowed from other loan systems (3 Nov 2026): 1. Collection cases open by days-late bucket, promises flip to Kept or Broken on their own (Frappe Lending, HES): case page and agency portal. 2. Checker inbox for actions above a limit (Mifos X): Second sign-offs. 3. IPRS and CRB panel per application, mismatches go to review, raw answers kept (Kenyan KYC providers): Checks board, bypassed until the keys. 4. Decision log with rule version (TurnKey Lender): Decision log tab. 5. Rollover, top-up and plan as separate linked actions with carried-forward arrears (Mambu): already in engine v2. 6. PAR 1/30/60/90 and ageing by product, officer and partner (Mifos): Revenue and Portfolio risk. 7. Monthly partner statements with yield (LendFoundry): partner Statement. 8. CRB submission file checked before it goes (Metropol, LendFoundry): Data checker rules.

wa-broker.text: Broker is now a partner type, not a role: short-term partners bring borrowers and fund them loan by loan; long-term partners fund lines. The data already works this way: a brokered loan points at a partner (loans.partner_id, broker_status), and the brokers row holds that partner's rates.
